properties.description: Daily medallion load: source -> bronze -> silver -> gold. Owner: data-eng. Expected duration ~30 min.

activities.name: Read source config
activities.description: List Files/config/sources/*.json (Get Metadata + ForEach, or a small notebook); keep enabled = true; pass dataset_id as p_source and source_type as p_source_type (sql | rest). Gold step then runs config/gold/* procedures in depends_on_gold order (dimensions before facts).

activities.name: Get watermark
activities.description: nb_metadata_ops(p_action=get_watermark, p_source) -> exit value .watermark (read via notebook, not the lakehouse SQL endpoint, which can lag behind Delta writes)

activities.name: Bronze - SQL copy
activities.description: If p_source_type = sql: incremental query WHERE ModifiedDate > watermark AND <= p_window_end -> lh_bronze Delta table (append, + _ingest_run_id)

activities.name: Bronze - API notebook
activities.description: If p_source_type = rest: nb_bronze_api_ingest(p_source, p_window_start=watermark, p_run_id=@pipeline().RunId)

activities.name: Silver - transform
activities.description: nb_silver_transform(p_source, p_run_id) - MERGE on business key + DQ

activities.name: Gold - load warehouse
activities.description: EXEC gold.usp_load_dim_customer; EXEC gold.usp_load_dim_product; EXEC gold.usp_load_fact_orders (Warehouse)

activities.name: Commit watermark
activities.description: Runs ONLY after gold succeeded: nb_metadata_ops(commit_watermark, p_value=new_watermark; watermark never moves backwards) then log_run per layer and log_dq (writes lh_metadata.meta.*)

activities.name: Notify on failure
activities.description: Email/Teams with @pipeline().RunId, pipeline name, p_source, error message. No row data.
